description: This file implements a command execution framework for a software project, including classes for managing execution context, building function parameters, and running commands asynchronously or synchronously. It interacts with system and user settings, handles warnings, logging, and charting, and defines core classes like CommandRunner, StaticCommandRunner, and ExecutionContext.

classes.name: ExecutionContext
classes.description: Holds context information for command execution, including command map, route, system settings, and user settings.

classes.name: ParametersBuilder
classes.description: Provides static methods to build, merge, validate, and manipulate function parameters for command execution.

classes.name: StaticCommandRunner
classes.description: Contains static methods to execute commands asynchronously, handle charting, and manage warnings and logging.

classes.name: CommandRunner
classes.description: Main class to initialize, manage, and run commands, supporting both async and sync execution modes.

methods.name: get_polished_parameter_list
methods.description: Returns the list of parameters for a given function signature.

methods.name: get_polished_func
methods.description: Removes specific parameters from a function's signature and annotations for command processing.

methods.name: merge_args_and_kwargs
methods.description: Merges positional args and keyword args into a single dictionary aligned with function parameters.

methods.name: update_command_context
methods.description: Adds command context ('cc') to kwargs if the function expects it.

methods.name: _warn_kwargs
methods.description: Warns about extra kwargs that are ignored by the validation model.

methods.name: _as_dict
methods.description: Converts an object to a dictionary safely.

methods.name: validate_kwargs
methods.description: Validates and coerces kwargs to match function signature types.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the final parameter dictionary for a function, merging args, kwargs, context, and validation.

methods.name: _command
methods.description: Runs a command function asynchronously and processes the result, including provider assignment.

methods.name: _chart
methods.description: Creates a chart from the command output if charting is available.

methods.name: _extract_params
methods.description: Extracts parameters from kwargs for charting or other purposes.

methods.name: _execute_func
methods.description: Executes a command function asynchronously, handles warnings, charting, and logging.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs a command asynchronously via the command map, returning an OBBject.

methods.name: sync_run
methods.description: Runs a command synchronously by wrapping the async run method.

methods.name: init_logging_service
methods.description: Initializes the logging service for the command runner.
